protocol_family: own public food series 2; same typed v3 work format, new immutable policy identifiers
reason: Cross-entropy is a proper scoring rule matching the trained distribution. The previous strict accuracy gate rejected four NLL improvements because two to four historical argmax byte predictions changed. The new policy retains historical NLL and measures accuracy diagnostically; it does not reinterpret previous receipts or claim lossless factual memory.

acceptance: Fresh development NLL gain >= max(1e-6,before*1e-5), historical development NLL must not increase, all scores finite and coverage fixed. Accuracy on both sets remains recorded. No earlier rejected candidate is promoted. AdamW moments and own initializer continue unchanged.
limits: Development evaluation is reused after initial prospective separation; no blinded generalization or answer-quality claim.
Historical aggregate NLL retention does not guarantee every remembered fact or response remains unchanged.
One locally selected lineage coordinator; no election or open consensus.
Only two physical PCs available; larger membership remains software-tested.
